ruling.explanation:
This decides route-deviation dispute DSP-02849 on trip TRP-02849. Both sides' surviving claims agree on the arithmetic, and the record supports them.

Deviation (POL-RD-01). The governing distance is the trace, not the trip record's rounded copy: EV-GPS-02849 trace_distance_km = 18.2 km against the booked optimal of 14.0 km, an excess of 4.2 km, i.e. 30.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (4.2 km > 0.8 km absolute; 30.0% > 20%). The excess is below both materiality ceilings (50% and 8.0 km), so this is an established but NOT MATERIAL deviation.

Evidence quality (POL-GEN-02, POL-RD-07). EV-GPS-02849 is impaired at the schema level: weight_multiplier 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW, a single 40.0 s gap with the bounding fixes 0.4 km apart at 08:00:59–08:01:39. It is NOT impaired for policy purposes: 40 s is below POL-RD-07(a)'s 90 s, 0.4 km is below limb (b)'s 500 m, and the 10 s sampling interval is below limb (c)'s 30 s. The artifact is therefore down-weighted only, the finding survives the discount (97.8% coverage, a short gap inside a stretch the trace otherwise observes), and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. My confidence is capped at 0.85 — the weight of the trace that carries the excess-distance figure. No independent artifact carries that figure: the trip record's actual_distance_km is the rounded copy of the same measurement, and the chat log is empty.

Exculpation. The chat log is empty (0 messages, no waypoint_hint), so POL-RD-04 exonerates nothing. No pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded and amended_optimal_distance_km is null, so POL-RD-05 does not run. The vehicle is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The driver's statement 'Navigation rerouted me' is a bare external-traffic assertion: EV-ADVIS-02849-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so the POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run and under POL-RD-13 the assertion carries no weight; because the driver named no advisory identifier, the missing advisory is a gap in the bundle and not an escalation under POL-RD-10(5). The deviation stands at 4.2 km against the booked 14.0 km optimal, and no advisory was on file.

Remedy (POL-RD-02; the fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-11 does not apply). recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 × 14.0 + 0.28 × 19.0) × 1.0 surge + 0.80 platform fee + 0.00 ERP = 19.62 + 0.80 = 20.42. charged_total = 26.73. Refund = 26.73 − 20.42 = 6.31, rounded up to 6.35. That is above the 0.50 de minimis floor and 23.6% of the charge, far below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. The surge multiplier of 1.0 was read from the fare breakdown, the only artifact carrying it. The rider's payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the 6.35 is money actually returned. The rider stated SGD 5.00 as contested; the policy sets no cap at that figure and its arithmetic yields 6.35.

POL-RD-09. The fare breakdown carries no ERP lines and no airport surcharge (the trip neither originates nor ends at an airport), so no pass-through correction is added and nothing is double-counted.

Driver profile (POL-RD-06). Not triggered — there is no material deviation — and on its own counters no pattern exists: deviation_flags_90d is 0 over completed_trips_90d 201. No full-refund uplift, no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral, and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral, since every charge line has a counterpart in the trip record and trace.

No escalation. Confidence 0.85 is above the 0.70 floor; the trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)–(c); timestamps agree; no exculpatory clause was invoked against a cited artifact; the refund is well below SGD 150.00 and below charged_total; the parties do not contradict each other; and no charge line is unmatched. Execution: the monetary effect of SGD 6.35 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling executes automatically; either party may appeal once within 30 days.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
